blocks.x: As air travel continues to be unpredictable, there’s never been a better time to hit the road. There are plenty of reasons to embark on road trips both big and small in 2026, from the 100th anniversary of Route 66 to the World Cup games taking place across the country. And car rental company Hertz is a reliable favorite, whether you’re hoping to cut costs on summer travel or make plans with more flexibility. Choose from a shiny catalog of cars, from family-friendly minivans and pickup trucks to luxury Porsches and electric vehicles. This spring, the company is adding the sporty Ineos Grenadier to its fleet; its many compartments make it ideal for tailgating summer concerts.

Hertz was founded by Walter Jacobs in 1918, who kicked things off with 12 used Model T’s. The company was then purchased by the eponymous John D. Hertz in 1923, who pioneered the “Hertz-Drive-Ur-Self” System. Hertz’s first airport car rental office opened at Chicago’s Midway Airport in 1932, and has been fueling adventurous travels ever since. Now, with over half a million rental cars in the US alone, the company boasts over 10,000 locations worldwide. Here’s how to save on your next rental car with promotions, free upgrades, and member discounts. And when you're done checking out what Hertz has to offer, make sure you have a look at the deals for Budget Rent a Car, Avis, Alamo, and Enterprise.
Book with Hertz for your next adventure this fall and get a 20% discount code

If you’ve got a leaf-peeping road trip in the works, get rewarded for planning early. Book a car for two or more days by September 14 and get 20% off your rental, with the pickup window running until December 15. The discount applies to all vehicles, excluding large SUV's, Dream cars, cargo, and box trucks. Be sure to use the code 212271 at the time of reservation.
Get one day free with seven+ day bookings with this Hertz coupon

From now until September 30, 2026, you can receive 1 free rental day when you rent from Hertz’s newest fleet for 7 or more consecutive days (with a 27-day maximum) across participating Hertz locations in the US and Canada—perfect for those lengthier, cross-country trips. Just be sure to use the promo code 210751 at the time of booking, otherwise the offer will be void.
Get up to 20% off at Hertz with a military & government discount code

Active duty military, veterans, and government employees can save up to 20% on base rates when booking leisure car rentals. This includes space-available upgrades and a complimentary Hertz Gold Plus Rewards membership, which gives you access to perks like skip-the-line and free rental days. Military members, be sure to use the specific Hertz discount code 2306779.
Save up to 20% with the 50 Plus Car Rental Program

Hertz’s 50 Plus Car Rental program allows travelers aged 50 and over to enjoy 20% off base rates on a wide range of vehicles for scenic rides across the country. If you’re one of these seasoned travelers, make sure you book with CDP# 2007815.
Save $50 on weekly SUV & minivan rentals with this Hertz discount code

Got a family trip in the works? Rent an SUV or minivan for seven consecutive days and get $50 off. Make sure you use the promo code 212131 at the time of booking, valid for reservations from now through September 30, 2026.
10% off EV and hybrid rentals with this Hertz promo code

If you're traveling with the environment in mind, Hertz is making it a bit easier on you. Those renting EV and hybrid rentals can save 10% off as long as pickup occurs by September 30, 2026. Use the promo code 212157 and keep in mind the discount applies to rentals of three days or more.
Free one-car-class upgrade on your next trip with this Hertz promo code

You’re on vacation, which means you deserve to drive in style. From now until September 30, enjoy a free, one-car-class upgrade when you reserve a medium sedan or higher. Be sure to use the promo code PC 211748 at the time of reservation.
Up to 25% off with the Hertz student discount

If you’re a student looking to get on the road, you can save up to 25% everyday base rates via Corporate Shopping. This includes a waived additional driver fee for a spouse or domestic partner in the US. To take advantage of this discount, make sure you enroll in Hertz Gold Plus Rewards.
Save up to 20% on base rates with a Hertz AAA discount

Thanks to its partnership with the American Automobile Association, AAA members can unlock benefits year-round, like 20% off base rates worldwide and 10% off prepaid fuel. Additionally, AAA members can save an additional $50 off monthly rentals and get one free day when they join the Hertz Gold+ loyalty program. It’s time to put that membership to good use.
Save extra with the Hertz Gold+ loyalty program

If you’re renting cars on the regular, consider signing up for the Hertz Gold+ loyaly program, which is entirely free to join. Members are able to skip the line at select locations, earn rewards points towards redeemable free car rental days, and receive extra perks like free additional drivers. The membership operates on a tier system, and the higher you go, the more additional perks, like larger selection of vehicles and free upgrades:
Gold gets you 1 point for every dollar spent, plus skip-the-line and members-only rates
Five Star promises 1.25, as well as a wider selection of premium vehicles and free upgrades
President’s Circle goes all the way to 1.5, with the largest selection of exclusive vehicles, guaranteed upgrades, and a dedicated customer service line
How to fix a Hertz discount code that’s not working

If your Hertz coupon code isn't working, be sure to check for typos, extra spaces, or incorrect capitalization, as well as any terms and conditions. You can also try clearing your browser’s cache and cookies, or switching devices or browsers. When all else fails, Hertz's Support Hub is there to help.
